references.text: The tabernacle was erected on the first day of the first month in the second year, as described here in connection with Moses' completion of its setup.
God commanded Moses to anoint the tabernacle, all its furnishings, the altar and all its utensils, to consecrate them.
The instructions for anointing the tent of meeting, the ark of the covenant, the table, the lampstand, the altar of incense, the bronze altar, and the basin with its base.
Moses anointed the tabernacle and everything in it, and consecrated them. He sprinkled oil on the altar seven times and anointed the altar with all its utensils.
Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, the courtyard, and the gate of the courtyard.
Moses sprinkled blood on the tabernacle and all the vessels used in worship, which points back to the anointing and consecration of the tabernacle.
